The third chart, titled "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal slices: "Conjunctive" in light pink-purple (50.49%) and "Disjunctive" in light blue-grey (49.51%). None of the charts include an external legend, as all category names and percentage values are bolded and centered within their respective pastel-colored slices, and there are no exploded or visually offset segments in any of the charts.
